resources.string: A supported F-Droid or GitHub build of Termux is installed. Open it to complete first-time setup if needed.
Install the latest stable Termux from F-Droid to provide the on-device terminal environment. The button opens its F-Droid page; installation is handled outside Pipkin.
Could not open Termux. Check that it is installed and enabled in Android settings.
Could not open the installation page. Open https://f-droid.org/packages/com.termux/ in a browser to install Termux.

Pipkin requires stable Termux 0.118.0 or newer from F-Droid or the official GitHub releases. Google Play and unrecognized builds are not supported. Get the latest stable version from F-Droid, or update from the same supported source you already use.

Back up your Termux files before switching installation sources. Different sources use different signing keys, so switching may require uninstalling Termux and its add-ons. Uninstalling deletes Termux data. Do not mix add-ons from different sources.
This Android permission allows Pipkin to execute commands in Termux, including reading, changing, or deleting files accessible to Termux.
This confirms the Android permission only. The separate allow-external-apps setting in Termux has not been checked.
Permission was not granted. If Android no longer shows the prompt, open Pipkin app settings and enable the Termux permission under Permissions. It may be listed under Additional permissions.
Could not open app settings. Open Android Settings, find Pipkin under Apps, and allow the Termux permission under Permissions.
Android blocked opening this screen. Check your device or work profile restrictions.

Pipkin starts a supervisor process inside Termux that runs the coding agent under Termux\'s identity, with Termux\'s file and network access. It keeps running after you leave Pipkin and stops after 15 minutes without a connected app or a running session. Stop it any time from this screen.
For long runs with the screen off, enable Termux\'s wake lock from its notification and exclude Termux from battery optimization. Pipkin holds a wake lock only while a session is working.
